title: The Heartsbane of Drustvar
summary: Ancient Drust hostility and the Waycrests' private grief converge in a witchcraft crisis across Drustvar.
opening: The silence of House Waycrest spread across its country. Beneath the curse lay an old enemy and a bargain made in desperation.
reviewNote: Capture the zone and Waycrest Manor quests for a complete chronology and resolution. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Review the Drust history behind Gorak Tul's return. Examine Lady Waycrest's plea and Gorak Tul's price. Follow Heartsbane influence through the settlements. Verify the family's fate and the campaign's aftermath.

chapters.title: The old grievance
chapters.body: Behind Drustvar’s present fear lay the older hostility of the Drust and the shadow of Gorak Tul.

chapters.title: The Waycrest bargain
chapters.body: Lady Waycrest’s grief drew her toward a desperate bargain. Gorak Tul’s price carried that private wound beyond the household.

chapters.title: A county under witchcraft
chapters.body: The Heartsbane’s influence spread through Drustvar’s settlements. The silence of House Waycrest became a country’s danger.

chapters.title: At Waycrest Manor
chapters.body: The family’s fate and the country’s recovery stand at the edge of this unfinished telling. The bargain’s consequences had reached far beyond the sorrow that began it.
